relationships.subject: Bushen Huoxue method
relationships.evidence_quote: Levels of IL-1, IL-6, and VEGF decreased significantly after treatment compared with before treatment (Figure 3) in the research group.

relationships.subject: Bushen Huoxue method
relationships.evidence_quote: After treatment, the levels of IL-1, IL-6, and PGE-2 in the joint fluid of patients in the research group were significantly lower than those in the control group (Figure 4).

key_findings: Bushen Huoxue plus PRP gave greater pain and WOMAC improvement than PRP alone in knee osteoarthritis.
Combination lowered serum IL-1, IL-6, VEGF and joint fluid IL-1, IL-6, PGE-2 more than PRP alone.
